scope: Evidence status of the on_track aggregates quoted in the README
claim: 11,115 in-envelope clusters -> 381 events -> 15 candidates over the six recordings
status: UNVERIFIED in this repository: the run wrote to build/, which is local-only, and results/ held no summary. The README now says so in place rather than presenting the numbers as measured.

partial_measurement.reading: consistent with the aggregate's shape but not a confirmation of it

outstanding: the full six-recording re-measurement (2488 scans) was launched twice and left to run; on a machine shared with other users it advanced through one recording in the time available, so it is recorded as outstanding with its command rather than reported as done.
why_not_just_delete_the_claim: the claim is useful - it is the probe's whole result - and deleting it would lose information. Marking its evidence status is the honest option, and it is the difference between a number someone can check and one they cannot.
